subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
Here the correct answer is** "as".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate answer for** blank number 4** is **2) as.**
 
• The word **"as"** is used to establish a comparison or similarity between two things.
 
• In this context, it is used to compare the width of the Sun to the width of the Earth.
 
 
• "It is about a hundred times **as wide as**__
